You're the fat cop working security at a discount grocery store. Watch the monitors, work out who's stealing, then waddle out and catch them before they reach the doors. You gas out fast.

1 – 9select a camera
SPACEdispatch to the selected subject

on the floor, that's “hey, put that back”

Watch the big monitor, not the list. A hand going to a coat is a thief; a man turning away to read the back of a box is not, and the analytics cannot tell them apart — it only says where to point the camera.

Roll up on an innocent shopper and you get a harassment complaint; three and you're back on traffic duty. Shouting “put that back” over the PA is the safe alternative — he might comply, he might look at you blankly, and everyone in the aisle hears it either way.
